amendmentHistory.description: TEXT CHANGES TO AMEND THE 1995 ADULT USE REGULATIONS, MODIFY THE DEFINITIONS OF ADULT EATING OR DRINKING ESTABLISHMENTS & OF WHAT CONSTITUTES ADULT THEATER & RELATED LOCATION REGS
VARIOUS MODIF OF THE ZR TO CLARIFY THAT NON-COMMERCIAL SIGNS AND SIGNS RELATING TO BUSINESSES ARE SUBJECT TO A UNIFORM SET OF REGULATIONS WHILE ADVERTISING SIGNS ARE SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL RULES

AMENDMENT TO DISCONTINUE MORATORIUM ON NEW ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS AND PROVIDE PERMANENT REGULATIONS ON THE SITING OF ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS TO PROTECT AGAINST THEIR ADVERSE EFFECTS WHILE ALLOWING SUFFICIENT ACCESS TO ADULT MATERIALS.
